semiconductor_relevance: Low — Bürkert Taiwan Ltd. primarily focuses on fluid and gas measurement and control systems, which are not directly related to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Bürkert Taiwan Ltd. specializes in fluid control systems, providing innovative solutions for measurement and control of fluids and gases. Their expertise includes customized systems for various industrial applications, but they do not specifically cater to semiconductor manufacturing needs.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Bürkert has established a branch in Taiwan since 1994, focusing on providing fluid control solutions.
